why_it_fails: Asks the reader to run a migration, with no action that runs it.

card.title: Run the billing migration tonight?
card.context: The new billing table is ready. Moving last month's invoices into it takes about ten minutes, during which invoices cannot be opened.
card.question: Can you run the billing migration tonight?

choices.label: Yes, I'll run it after 10 pm
Wait for the weekend
choices.cons: the old table keeps growing for four days

card.why: Ten quiet minutes tonight beats four more days of invoices in the old table.
